description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1779/35 of 04.12.2012 in the Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510286
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing corrections and expungements of land parcel details (parcel numbers, extent measurements, access particulars) for specific land parcels in various locations. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves land administration matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
